info.title: ApiCore Server
info.description: OpenAPI reference for ApiCore Server base endpoints and optional modules. Auth, passkey, and oauth modules are optional and require the corresponding module to be enabled in the ApiServer config. Base endpoints are always available.

tags.name: base
tags.description: Base endpoints always available in ApiServer.

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Optional auth module endpoints. Requires the auth module to be enabled in the ApiServer config.

tags.name: passkey
tags.description: Optional passkey module endpoints. Requires passkey support to be enabled in the ApiServer auth config.

tags.name: oauth
tags.description: Optional OAuth module endpoints. Requires OAuth support to be enabled in the ApiServer auth config.

get.description: Auth: none. Returns ApiResponse<ApiPingRes> with server health and version metadata.

post.description: Auth: strict. Removes expired MIME staging files and incomplete TUS uploads. Completed TUS uploads are preserved.
Auth: none. Issues access and refresh tokens for valid credentials.
Auth: required. Reissues tokens using a refresh token supplied in the body or refresh cookie.

post.summary: Logout and revoke the refresh token
post.description: Auth: required. Revokes the refresh token supplied in the body or refresh cookie and clears auth cookies.

get.description: Auth: required. Resolves the effective user from the access token and includes the real user when impersonating.
Auth: required. Returns safe session metadata with non-secret sessionId handles. Raw access and refresh tokens are never returned.

delete.description: Auth: required. Revokes a session by non-secret sessionId, scoped to the authenticated user.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: Non-secret session handle returned by GET /api/auth/v1/me/sessions.

post.description: Auth: strict. Issues tokens for a target user when impersonation is permitted.

403.description: Impersonation not permitted or user not found.

delete.description: Auth: strict. Reissues tokens for the real user to end impersonation. Optional token metadata is read from query parameters, not the request body.

parameters.name: keepSession
parameters.description: Boolean or TTL controlling refresh cookie persistence for the replacement tokens.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Space-delimited scope string or repeated query parameter values.

post.description: Auth: optional. Creates a passkey challenge for register or authenticate flows. The authenticate flow is public and can omit a user identifier to allow discoverable credentials. Register challenges require the authenticated, non-impersonating actor to match the target user.

403.description: Passkey registration is not allowed while impersonating and must target the authenticated user.

post.description: Auth: optional. Verifies a passkey response and issues tokens on success. Authentication verification is public. Registration verification requires the authenticated, non-impersonating actor to match the challenge user before any credential is persisted.

401.description: Passkey verification failed, or passkey registration verification was attempted without authentication.

403.description: Passkey registration is not allowed while impersonating, must target the authenticated user, or the user could not be resolved.

get.description: Auth: strict. Returns passkey credentials for the authenticated user.

delete.description: Auth: strict. Deletes the passkey credential identified by the path parameter.

post.description: Auth: none. Starts an external OAuth flow for the provider.
Auth: none. Completes the provider callback and returns the provider result.
Auth: optional. Issues an authorization code for a registered redirect URI. Public clients must use PKCE; S256 is the secure default. Requested scopes must be allowed by the client record.

post.summary: Exchange a code or refresh token
post.description: Auth: none. Exchanges an authorization code or refresh token for OAuth tokens; client authentication may be required.

options.description: Auth: none. Returns protocol limits and supported TUS extensions in response headers.

post.description: Auth: required. Creates an incomplete upload after validating its declared size and client-supplied metadata.

201.description: Upload created. The response has no body.

Location.description: URL for subsequent HEAD, PATCH, and DELETE requests.

Upload-Expires.description: Expiry time for an incomplete upload.

400.description: Invalid TUS headers or upload length.

403.description: Authenticated user is not allowed to create the upload.

413.description: Declared upload size exceeds the configured limit.

head.description: Auth: required. Returns the current offset and declared size in response headers.

parameters.name: uploadId
parameters.description: Opaque upload identifier returned in the Location header.

200.description: Upload state returned in headers. The response has no body.

Upload-Length.description: Declared total upload size in bytes.

Upload-Expires.description: Expiry time for an incomplete upload.

404.description: Upload not found. The response has no body.

410.description: Incomplete upload expired. The response has no body.

patch.description: Auth: required. Appends one binary chunk at the current upload offset.

parameters.name: uploadId
parameters.description: Opaque upload identifier returned in the Location header.

parameters.name: Upload-Offset
parameters.description: Expected current upload offset in bytes.

204.description: Chunk accepted. The response has no body.

Upload-Expires.description: Expiry time for an incomplete upload.

400.description: Invalid TUS headers or chunk body.

404.description: Upload not found. The response has no body.

409.description: Upload offset mismatch. The response has no body.

410.description: Incomplete upload expired. The response has no body.

413.description: Chunk exceeds the configured chunk or upload limit.

delete.description: Auth: required. Deletes an upload when the configured store supports termination.

parameters.name: uploadId
parameters.description: Opaque upload identifier returned in the Location header.

204.description: Upload deleted. The response has no body.

404.description: Upload not found. The response has no body.

405.description: The configured store does not support deletion. The response has no body.

410.description: Incomplete upload expired. The response has no body.

get.summary: Discover the optional standard OAuth authorization server
get.description: Auth: none. Mounted only by OAuthAuthorizationServer. The well-known path includes the configured issuer path. Returns RFC 8414 metadata as raw JSON.

Auth: none. Optional OAuthAuthorizationServer route. The application callback must authenticate the browser user and obtain consent. Requires S256 PKCE for every client. Validated redirects contain code or error, state, and iss.

302.description: Redirect to the registered callback, or an application-owned login flow.

400.description: OAuth protocol error. No tokens are returned.

500.description: OAuth protocol error. No tokens are returned.

post.summary: Exchange or refresh a standard OAuth grant
post.description: Auth: optional. Optional OAuthAuthorizationServer route. Confidential clients authenticate with HTTP Basic or client_secret_post; public clients identify themselves with client_id and use PKCE. Returns raw OAuth JSON, disables caching, and rotates refresh tokens.

200.description: OAuth access and refresh token pair.

400.description: OAuth protocol error. No tokens are returned.

401.description: OAuth protocol error. No tokens are returned.

500.description: OAuth protocol error. No tokens are returned.

accessTokenBearer.description: JWT access token via Authorization: Bearer <token>.

accessTokenCookie.name: dat
accessTokenCookie.description: Access token cookie (default name "dat", configurable via ApiServerConf.accessCookie).

refreshTokenCookie.name: drt
refreshTokenCookie.description: Refresh token cookie (default name "drt", configurable via ApiServerConf.refreshCookie).

apiKeyBearer.description: API key via Authorization: Bearer <secret> (or Bearer <prefix><secret> when apiKeyPrefix is configured). Requires apiKeyEnabled=true on the server, or a route with auth type 'apikey'. API keys support optional impersonation: when the key record includes an euid, the request acts as the effective user while getRealUid() returns the key owner.

requestSignature.name: X-ApiCore-Signature
requestSignature.description: HMAC or custom request signature. The default HMAC signer also requires X-ApiCore-Timestamp. Runtime route policy determines which operations require signing.

SafeUser.description: Filtered user representation returned by storage.filterUser().

ApiResponse.description: ApiResponse<T> standard envelope used by all endpoints (success or error). T is the endpoint-specific payload type carried in the data field. Mirrors ApiResponseShape.

code.description: HTTP status code mirrored in the body.

message.description: Message string; may be defaulted by the client.

errors.description: Field-level validation errors keyed by field name.

startedAt.description: Server start time as milliseconds since epoch.

UploadPurgeResult.description: Uploads and content bytes removed from one upload store.

UploadPurgeSummary.description: Result of purging upload files older than the configured expiry.

SessionInfo.description: Safe session metadata. Token secrets are never included.

sessionId.description: Non-secret session handle used for revocation.

tokenHint.description: Display-only masked refresh-token suffix. Do not use as an identifier.

keepSession.description: Boolean or TTL controlling refresh cookie persistence.

token.description: Refresh token; falls back to cookie when omitted.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token alternative to token; falls back to the configured refresh cookie when omitted.

PasskeyChallenge.description: Challenge payload returned when initiating a passkey operation.

ApiPasskeyDeleteRes.description: Payload returned after deleting a passkey credential.

PasskeyChallengeRequest.description: Passkey challenge request. action='authenticate' is public and may omit login/userId to allow discoverable credentials. action='register' requires the caller to be authenticated as the target user and not be impersonating.

action.description: 'authenticate' is public. 'register' requires authenticated self-enrollment for the target user.

PasskeyVerifyRequest.description: Passkey verification request. Authentication verification is public. Registration verification requires the same authenticated, non-impersonating actor that initiated the registration challenge.

codeChallenge.description: PKCE code challenge. Requires codeChallengeMethod when present.

codeChallengeMethod.description: PKCE method for codeChallenge. Must be supplied when codeChallenge is present.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token alternative to the configured refresh cookie.

scope.description: Space-delimited scopes requested for the replacement token.

ApiOAuthStartRes.description: Provider-specific start payload (e.g. redirect URL, state).

ApiOAuthCallbackRes.description: Provider-specific callback payload (may include tokens and user).

redirectUri.description: Redirect URI to continue the OAuth flow.

ApiOAuthTokenRes.description: OAuth access and refresh token response.

ApiLoginRes.description: Access and refresh tokens paired with the signed-in user.

ApiRefreshRes.description: Access and refresh tokens returned by /auth/v1/refresh.

ruser.description: Real user when the token is impersonating another effective user.
